name: Rats in the Millrace
summary: Thin out the rats and reed hens in Millrace Fields.
startText: The millers say they cannot open a sack without a rat in it. Take the east road into Millrace Fields and thin them out: six rats, four reed hens.
inProgressText: Six millrace rats and four reed hens, east of the Ford.
completionText: The millers will sleep tonight. Your pay, and something for the road.
